summary: A 19-year-old bypassed the park entry gate at high speed; the vehicle was found three miles down East Portal Road, off the side about 150 feet down a slope, empty, with signs the driver's head hit the windshield; an area search with ground teams, dogs, and drones (Montrose County, NPS, Gunnison SAR) began October 28; the individual was found deceased on November 5 by drone at the base of cliffs and the body was recovered with technical rope rescue techniques.
location: East Portal Road, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP
responding_agency: Montrose County Sheriff's Office; NPS Black Canyon rangers; Gunnison SAR; Montrose County Coroner
notes: NPS morning-report entries dated 2024-11-13 (sources: Montrose Press, Idaho Statesman). Individual was the vehicle's registered owner; phone and wallet left behind. 2024-10-28 is the incident-start date; body found 2024-11-05.
